headline: Is Lockheed Martin (LMT) Below Fair Value After Its $59B Contract?
summary: Lockheed Martin stock has delivered an 86.2% total return over the past five years, yet current valuation checks and an intrinsic value estimate based on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) approach both point to the shares trading below that intrinsic value by a meaningful margin. An 86.2% return over five years leaves existing holders with solid gains, while raising the question of whether the current price still leaves room for further upside.
